  "Airline" INTEGER,
  "FlightNo" INTEGER,
  "SourceAirport" TEXT,
  "DestAirport" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("Airline", "FlightNo"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("DestAirport") REFERENCES "airports" ("AirportCode"),

arguments.sql: SELECT AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT SourceAirport AS AirportCode FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT DestAirport FROM flights) GROUP BY AirportCode ORDER BY cnt ASC LIMIT 1
